query:
SELECT m."libraryId" AS library_id, m."folderName" AS folder, l."path" AS library_path,
                  mf."relativePath" AS stored
           FROM media_files mf
           LEFT JOIN media m ON m."id" = mf."mediaId"
           LEFT JOIN libraries l ON l."id" = m."libraryId"
           WHERE mf."id" = $1
